what: E: enter Firefly Jar; read the frame's attributes

actions.eval: (() => { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].map(x => ({ src: x.src, sandbox: x.getAttribute('sandbox'), allow: x.getAttribute('allow'), w: x.getBoundingClientRect().width, h: x.getBoundingClientRect().height })); const layers = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-layer]')].map(x => x.getAttribute('data-layer') + ': ' + x.innerText.slice(0, 300)); return JSON.stringify({ frames: f, layers }) })()
